zh-CN.name: 包容性设计
zh-CN.description: 从被当前方案排除的人和情境出发，通过参与和替代路径减少不必要障碍。包容性设计比可访问性检查的范围更广，不能用一个假想“平均用户”代表所有人。
use_when: 能力、语言、设备、网络或情境差异会影响完成任务。
能让不同背景的用户参与设计与验证。
avoid_when: 不要靠人口标签推断所有人的需要。
不能用单一替代方式覆盖所有障碍。
zh-CN.prompt_template: 识别核心任务中谁被排除及其具体情境，邀请相关用户参与检查；为输入、阅读和恢复提供可选择路径；验证不同语言、辅助技术、设备和连接条件，不强迫所有人使用同一种交互。

en.name: Inclusive Design
en.description: A design approach that starts with people and contexts excluded by the current solution and uses participation and alternatives to reduce barriers. Its scope extends beyond an accessibility checklist; one imagined average user cannot represent everyone.
use_when: Ability, language, device, connectivity or context affects task completion.
People with varied backgrounds can participate in design and evaluation.
avoid_when: Do not infer everyone’s needs from demographic labels alone.
One alternative cannot address every barrier.
en.prompt_template: Identify who is excluded from core tasks and under what conditions, and involve those users in evaluation. Provide alternative paths for input, reading and recovery. Check languages, assistive technologies, devices and connection conditions without forcing one interaction method.
